parent_objective: design bounded fresh task-source generation from M1677 metadata mapping before rollout
blocked_by: need fresh bounded task-source specs because M1615 is diagnostic metadata only and cannot be a direct benchmark
supersedes: direct controller-family rollout on M1615 rows

public_gates: M1679 must design bounded task-source generation without executing it
M1679 must generate from source-family/edge/window metadata rather than M1615 hidden/action labels
M1679 must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, and L3-reset controls
M1679 must include source-family caps and no-profile-specific-tuning rules
M1679 must keep private holdout promotion actor-input changes paper-level claims and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M1615 hidden tensors or actions as benchmark targets

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs fresh bounded task-source generation route from audited metadata before execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no task materialization, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if design uses M1615 hidden/action labels as targets
stop if control-substitution profiles are not mandatory
stop if source caps and no profile-specific tuning rules are omitted
stop if implementation or rollout is admitted directly
fallback_plan: route to fresh source-generation preflight if design is feasible
route to mapping repair if audited metadata is insufficient
route to standard-layer negative story only if task-source generation is impossible under current sim
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1678 audits the metadata branch and opens a new bounded task-source generation branch

admission_evidence: M1678 audits M1677 as metadata-positive with 62 rows, 12 source families, 2 task families, 15 edges, 5 windows, and zero leakage guardrail violations
allowed_updates: M1679 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for no-training source-generation preflight if design passes
next_stage_criteria: fresh task-source generation design is explicit
next no-training preflight route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; generated tasks must be designed to challenge L1 current response, L2 current-tiled windows, and L3 reset control.
history_necessity_tests: design must require L2 normal versus current-tiled comparison
design must require L3 online versus reset comparison
design must not claim self-identification until generated tasks produce outcome evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1677 metadata mapping and M1678 audit only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If fresh task-source generation cannot make current-substitution controls fail, record scenario-sampling limitation instead of weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no task materialization, no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded fresh task-source generation route can convert the audited M1677 metadata mapping into controller-family-compatible task specs without leaking L3-specific proof artifacts.
success_criteria: design uses source-family edge window metadata rather than hidden/action labels
design specifies source caps and T4/T5 balance
design chooses one no-training task-source preflight or stop route
training replay PPO environment rollout promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design uses M1615 hidden/action labels as task targets
design omits source caps or control-substitution profiles
design routes directly to rollout private holdout promotion or paper evidence
design claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID
decision_rule: M1679 passes if it designs a bounded no-execution task-source generation route from audited metadata.
